message: Windows look out of Dining, Guest, Kitchen, Living, Study. Whether any of them frames something worth keeping is a judgement this model cannot make: it knows a window exists and nothing about what is outside it. Alexander's claim in 134 is that a view on continuous display stops being seen, so the question is which outlook to frame and which to screen -- decided on site, not here.
